output.headerText:
PiCode — modification layer on top of VSCodium.
This pack does NOT contain the VSCodium tree (picode-source/src): for that there is the LSP index and codegraph.
It contains: build scripts (dev/), distribution, documentation and tasks (docs/),
the pi extension (extensions/picode), the durable agent and its bridges (durable*, ADR-020),
and the parts of the build system PiCode touches (build/next, build/win32, vscode gulpfiles).
Regenerate: repomix (reads this file).
